newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Sungei Way buys stake in Gopeng.
newsitem.headline: Sungei Way buys stake in Gopeng.

text.p: Sungei Way Holdings Bhd said it has acquired a 22.7 percent stake in Gopeng Bhd for 222.93 million ringgit.
The company said in a statement that it has paid 5.49 ringgit per share and all the purchases have been made through the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.
It said it has also acquired 23.73 million warrants in Gopeng at 2.86 ringgit each.

Another Sungei Way subsidiary, Sungei Way Leasing Sdn Bhd, was acquiring six percent stake in Perak Hanjoong Simen Sdn Bhd for 77.77 million ringgit. Perak Hanjoong is a 45-percent owned associated of Gopeng.
Sungei Way Leasing was also buying another six percent stake in Perak Hanjoong Holdings Bhd for 77.77 million ringgit from Proselesa Sdn Bhd.
Sungei Way Leasing's acquisitions are through its wholly-owned subsidiary SWL Factoring Sdn Bhd.

Simultaneously, Sungei Way Holdings would transfer the entire equity interest in SWL Factoring Sdn Bhd to associate Sunway Building Technology Bhd as part of an elaborate restructuring in the Sungei Way group.
The Sungei Way statement said the exercise would "lead to the listing of Perak Hanjoong Simen under a new holding company, Perak Hanjoong Holdings Bhd".
The corporate exercise would also increase Sungei Way's equity in Sunway Technology to 54.9 percent from 41.4.
Sunway Technology would eventually hold 22.8 percent of Perak Hanjoong Holdings through SWL Factoring and Sungei Way will hold around 24 percent of Gopeng's equity.
Perak Hanjoong Holdings will hold at least 86 percent of Perak Hanjoong Simen, the statement said.
